title: Serialization of a multitape machine
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set of size $n+1$. Its serialization is the self-delimiting pairing of the bit representation of $n$ with the unary encoding of its initial state followed by the bit encoding of its transition table.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic $k$-work-tape machine over Boolean symbols with $n+1$ states
